name: Scott's Tweaks
description: Scott's organized gameplay menu: selectable Crystal/Battle Art Gen 1-5 sprites, native-pixel Pocket Bag and responsive PC skins, four-card Pokegear, Buddy/All EXP.SHARE, independent trainer/boss/wild difficulty, Trade Stone, trainer forfeits and rematches, Oak's spare starter, B-button running, badge-free field moves, visible wild Pokemon, followers, Free Fly, and automatic physical-Thor dual-screen control. The built-in original-style Kanto voxel renderer adds optional real Gen 1 ledge depth, safe third-person rooms, pixel horizons, elevated sun travel, later-rising lunar phases, pinned-night Full/New Moon choices, a phase-aware Milky Way, Scott's catalog-positioned block-pixel astrophotography, and optional local-season weather.
